verdict.rationale: Notte is built API-first: sessions, scraping, vaults, and scripts are all exposed via authenticated API endpoints, and CLI/MCP interfaces let agents drive the same browser sessions the dashboard 'Live View' merely visualizes (notte-docs-2, notte-docs-17, notte-docs-9, notte-probe-3). However, there's no explicit documentation asserting full UI/API parity, and the OpenAPI spec is not publicly discoverable (404s on standard paths), leaving some doubt about full endpoint coverage. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement or spec confirming every UI action has an API equivalent, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this parity.
